correctness.rationale: From Pinsky exact product identity E R_n = sum_{k=1}^{N-1}p_{N,k}(1+1/k), N=n+1, p product_{j=1}^k(1-j/N). Independent exact Fraction checks n=1..8 matched the alternative expression in the actual Pinsky v5 PDF. On k<=sqrt(N)log N, expand log p=-u^2/2-N^-1/2(u/2+u^3/6)+uniform summable remainder; Gaussian tails bound omitted k. Euler–Maclaurin contributes -1/2 and first correction -5/6, hence U=sqrt(pi N/2)-4/3+o(1). A harmonic Gaussian Riemann integral gives V=0.5log(2N)+gamma/2+o(1). Converting N to n preserves o(1). Independent numeric error relative to three terms at n=10^6 was -0.00010369. No variance or distributional claim.
